summary:
PASS 2 grind (2026-08-05): re-verified every non-match item against the CURRENT tree (it moved under later cross-surface passes — most visibly, an icons-and-buttons pass 2 already landed DetailSlot's collapse-to-strip, closing half of the PASS 1 'deviates' finding before this pass even started). Two real fixes this pass: (1) FilesLayer.tsx's `buildFileTree` checked only `file.type !== 'directory'`, but the LIVE wire (probed directly against 127.0.0.1:17900's `/v1/workspaces/{id}/files`) spells directories `"dir"` — confirmed live: `{"path":".claude","type":"dir"}` ahead of its own children as separate entries. SessionView.tsx's `@`-picker filter already had the correct `type !== 'dir' && type !== 'directory'` check a few lines away; FilesLayer.tsx just never got the same fix. Every directory entry (and, worse, ALL of its children, permanently nested under a node stuck at type 'file') rendered as a flat doc-icon row with no chevron — visually confirmed via a fresh panels-files.png composite showing the app's `.claude`/`.clio`/etc. root now chevron correctly. Two failing-first regression tests lock the real wire spelling (verified red against the pre-fix code, green after). (2) DetailSlot's chrome is now fully built (kind badge, copy-as-markdown, honestly-degraded download, maximize-into-Layer, collapse-to-strip, breadcrumb) and re-verified visually via the `?shell` fixture harness (no side-by-side setup exists for the detail slot specifically) plus the full 17-test detail.test.tsx suite, all green — upgraded PASS 1's 'deviates' to 'match'. Bonus: fixed the side-by-side tooling gap PASS 1 flagged as a follow-up — scripts/side-by-side.mjs's console setup now stubs `window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke` for the one `gact_http` command it needs (proxying to a real fetch) instead of leaving every backend call broken once `window.isTauri` is spoofed, so the console dock now ALSO has a verified composite for the first time in this campaign. The Detail Slot's REACHABILITY from the live transcript remains unattempted and correctly so: it is explicitly out of this surface's scope (tracked separately as backlog item E7, 'mint real artifacts and ground the chips') and needs real backend-grounded transcript changes (minting real artifact/answer/agent records the chips can point at), not a panels-chrome fix — re-verified this pass that SessionView.tsx still never passes AppShell a `detail` prop, only ShellPreview.tsx's dev harness does.

PASS 3 grind (2026-08-05): re-verified all 13 items against the current tree (Topbar.tsx unchanged since PASS 2; a cross-surface hover-parity pass touched only observability.css, not the context-tab component this file measures; FilesLayer/ConsoleDock unchanged). Only the Detail slot chrome item was still non-match, and it was stale: an icons-and-buttons PASS 3 (commit b921a7f7, same day, prior to this pass) had already wired the download menu for real against the live GET /v1/artifacts/{artifact_id}/export route — re-verified that fix live here (29-test detail.test.tsx green, composite regenerated) and upgraded to match. Swept the item for the SAME CLASS of gap the download fix closed (a real route standing behind an inert control) and found one more, smaller one in the breadcrumb sub-element this item's own proto_truth names: the separator glyph was a hardcoded '/' where the prototype's own template byte-decodes to '›' (U+203A, verified via a raw byte read of design/prototype/Clio Session.html, not a console print — the terminal was mangling the glyph to U+FFFD on display), and every prototype crumb is a real <button> (sc-camel-on-click) where this build rendered inert <span>s despite the ArtifactRecord type's own doc-comment already promising 'Clickable trail'. Fixed conservatively, not by inventing a multi-level stack this app's data model doesn't have: the first ('session') crumb is now a real button wired to onClose (the one crumb with a well-defined destination — 'go up from a single record' means 'leave the detail slot'), the trailing/self crumb stays a plain span (matches the prototype's own observable no-op there). Locked by 3 new failing-first tests (verified red against the pre-fix code via a targeted git-stash rerun, green after) plus the existing 26. Also fixed the ShellPreview.tsx dev-harness fixture, which never supplied a breadcrumb at all (so the composite under-demonstrated an already-built, already-tested feature) — cosmetic to the fixture only, no production code path changed. Regenerated all 5 of this surface's composites (files/console/artifacts/context/detail) against a fresh build; all match the prototype's grammar by eye, no other regressions found. The Detail Slot reachability item is unchanged and re-confirmed still out of scope — still tracked as backlog item E7, still a genuine unbacked wire gap, not silently omitted.

items.element: Topbar surface toolbar — button row order/grammar (files, console, artifacts N, ctx N%, eye icon)
items.proto_truth: 5 pills in this exact order after the breadcrumb spacer: 'files' (folder icon), 'console' (terminal icon, isDesktop-only), 'artifacts {{obsArtCount}}' (icon hardcoded color:var(--t-cy,#0aa6ad)), 'ctx {{ctxPct}}' (bars icon), icon-only gauge button title='Observability'. Measured from audit-proto.json: JetBrains Mono 11.5px, color rgb(138,147,162) default, padding 3px 8px, radius 5px, gap 5px; x-positions files=1019 console=1096 artifacts=1188 ctx=1305 (w70/83/109/81).

items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/shell/Topbar.tsx onTogglePanel('files') → SessionView.tsx sets panel='files' → <FilesLayer open={panel==='files'} .../> renders a <Layer> modal (apps/web/src/session/FilesLayer.tsx), matching the prototype's own layerFiles grammar. items.element: Files Layer content — tree sidebar + file preview + attach-to-message
items.proto_truth: Modal window (LayerChrome, width×height=winW×winH, 8vh top margin): header folder-icon + 'files' + path meta (fsRootPath) + 'browse…' button + maximize/pop-out/close; body = resizable tree column (filter input, chevron/folder rows, size right-aligned e.g. '48 KB') + right content pane showing selected file path, raw content, 'ATTACH TO MESSAGE' button, and a 'SAVE' button. Re-measured directly from design/prototype/Clio Session.html: winW=680 (default), winH=72vh, bpTreeW=210; on-browse/on-close are the LayerChrome props (no on-maximize/on-popout prop is passed for the files/blueprint/provider-config layers — only Observability's own markup has window controls, so this window correctly has no maximize/pop-out either).
items.audit_correction: PASS 1 was downgraded match -> deviates by an independent audit (2026-08-04): the live wire's GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/files returns entries typed `"dir"` (probed directly against 127.0.0.1:17900), but FilesLayer.tsx:59,64 classified with `file.type !== 'directory'` — `'dir' !== 'directory'` is always true, so every leaf dir entry was misclassified as a FILE, and every one of ITS CHILDREN got permanently nested under a node stuck at type 'file' too (the child's own file entries are typed correctly, but the parent directory node they hang off never gets promoted back to 'directory', so `node.type === 'directory' && isOpen` never renders them). PASS 2 (2026-08-05) fixed it: `isDirectoryType()` now accepts both `'dir'` and `'directory'`, re-probed live against ws_default (`D:\Libraries\Documents\projects\clio-agent`) to confirm the exact wire shape before writing the fix, not from the prior audit's word alone.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/session/FilesLayer.tsx — real folder tree grouped client-side from the flat backend listing (buildFileTree), chevron expand/collapse (root level open by default, deeper levels closed, filtering force-opens ancestors of a match), filter input, size column, and a preview pane with a WORKING 'attach to message' (inserts `@path` into the composer draft — the prototype's own button has no click handler at all, a static mockup element, so this is a functional improvement) and an honestly-degraded, permanently-disabled 'save' (no workspace file-write endpoint exists) and 'browse…' (no filesystem traversal above the registered workspace root exists). Tests: tests/unit/panels-conformance.test.tsx ('files layer' describe blocks, 5 tests, PLUS a new 'the wire spells directories "dir", not "directory"' describe block with 2 failing-first regression locks verified red against the pre-fix code) + tests/unit/owner-review-1.test.tsx. Composite: panels-files.png, regenerated this pass against the live ws_default workspace — the app pane now shows a real chevroned `.agents`/`.claude`/`.clio`/`.clio_agent`/… tree matching the prototype's grammar instead of a flat file list. Not built: the drag-to-resize corner handle (dragWin) — cosmetic, not requested by this item's acceptance.
items.backend_surface: GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/files, GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/files/read — consumed. No write/save endpoint and no filesystem-traversal-above-root endpoint exist — both wire gaps, both visibly marked (data-unbacked, disabled, explanatory title), never silently omitted.

items.element: 'console' topbar button — presence gate and click target
items.proto_truth: <sc-if value="{{ isDesktop }}">…console button…</sc-if> — the ONLY toolbar control gated on desktop; click toggles the bottom workspace-console dock (consoleOpen).
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/kit/useIsDesktop.ts (gate) + apps/web/src/shell/Topbar.tsx (application) — unchanged, correct going into this pass. Click opens apps/web/src/session/ConsoleDock.tsx via SessionView's dock prop (panel==='console'). Re-verified by source read this pass; tests/unit/owner-review-1.test.tsx exercises the open+close.

items.proto_truth: Resizable dock anchored to the bottom of the center column (not a right/side panel): tab bar ('bash' + '+' new-shell + per-tab close), drag-to-resize handle, REPL body with cyan prompt (e.g. 'j4471@ares:j4471$'), command echo, gray output, live input line.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/session/ConsoleDock.tsx — dock anchored via AppShell's `dock` slot below the center column (not a side panel), tab pill ('bash' + disabled '+' new-console), resize-handle strip, a cyan '$' prompt line, and an explicit, honest unbacked marker (data-unbacked='true') explaining no session shell/PTY wire surface exists — the correct degraded behavior, not a gap to hide. Component unchanged this pass. PASS 2 (2026-08-05) fixed the tooling blocker PASS 1 deferred: scripts/side-by-side.mjs's console setup now stubs `window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke` for the `gact_http` command (proxies to a real browser fetch and returns the `RustHttpResponse` shape tauriFetch expects) instead of only spoofing `window.isTauri`, so the app's boot probe no longer crashes once the console button's desktop gate is satisfied. Composite: panels-console.png, generated for the first time this campaign — confirms the dock anchoring, tab bar, and honest degraded body all match the prototype's console-dock grammar. The prompt still reads a generic '$' rather than a realistic 'user@host:path$' — a minor remaining content gap, unchanged.
items.fix_hint: Minor, not this pass: give ConsoleDock a placeholder prompt string closer to the prototype's own realistic 'user@host:path$' rather than a bare '$'.

Tests: tests/unit/owner-review-1.test.tsx, tests/unit/panels-conformance.test.tsx. Composite: panels-artifacts.png, regenerated this pass against a live materio-md session (both the prototype and app side still correctly open the observability layer on the artifacts tab).

items.element: Observability Layer window chrome (scrim, card, header icon+title+meta, maximize / pop-out / close)
items.proto_truth: Fixed inset:0 scrim + centered card (width×height, 8vh top margin, --t-sf bg, --t-bd6 hairline, 12px radius, --t-shadow, clio-rise 160ms); dc-import 'LayerChrome' header: eye icon, 'observability' heading, 'session trace · live' meta; corner drag-resize handle.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/kit/Layer.tsx — unchanged, still correct. Now also reused (via the new headerActions slot) by the files layer's degraded browse button.

items.proto_truth: Rich panel (walk-ctx-panel.png / proto-obs-context.png): a filled progress bar labelled 'context window' with '82.1k / 200k · 41%'; three stat tiles — RELAY LATENCY '12 ms' / 'clio-relay (ares)', THINKING TOKENS '600' / '2 blocks', COST '$0.31' / 'incl. subagents'; an orange-bordered 'LIVE NOW · 3' box listing live async jobs (e.g. 'stripe-tuner · getstripe 6,143/9,800 · 12.4k tok ↑').
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/Observability.tsx's ContextTab now renders the same grammar: a 'context window' label + '{tokens} / {limit} · {percent}%' row, a filled progress bar, a 3-tile row (RELAY LATENCY / THINKING TOKENS / COST), and an orange-bordered 'live now · N' box built from the SAME `runs` array the runs tab already shows (filtered to non-terminal states) — no separate fetch. Composite: panels-context.png, near-pixel match on chrome. Tests: tests/unit/panels-conformance.test.tsx ('observability context tab' describe, 4 tests).
items.backend_surface: fetchSessionContextState supplies usedPercent/tokens/limit (unchanged). COST is now real — summed `cost_usd` across the session's messages (a real per-message wire field), shown only when at least one message actually reported one. RELAY LATENCY and THINKING TOKENS have NO wire source anywhere in the app (grepped the whole wire/client layer) — rendered as an explicit 'not reported' tile (data-unbacked='true') rather than fabricated or silently dropped. Per-job progress fractions and token throughput in the live-now box (e.g. '6,143/9,800 · 12.4k tok ↑') are similarly unbacked — ObsRun only carries label/agent/state/host/duration, so the live-now rows show those four fields honestly rather than invented numbers.
items.fix_hint: If/when a relay-latency or thinking-token-count wire field ships, wire it into ObsContext the same way costUsd was added; per-job live throughput would need ObsRun extended with real progress/token fields from the backend, not estimated client-side.

items.element: Detail slot (right pane) — reachability from the live app
items.proto_truth: Opens beside the transcript (not an overlay) when a user clicks an artifact/answer/agent affordance inline in a message (e.g. 'Open artifact', an answer's inline chip, or shift-click on an agent handoff). Default width 480px (`s.rightW || 480`), border-left, flex:0 0 auto — a true right-hand pane, distinct from the files/console/artifacts/ctx overlay layers (which are now correctly NOT using this slot — see above).
items.app_evidence: Re-verified this pass (PASS 3, 2026-08-05), still deliberately out of scope: grepped apps/web/src for every `DetailSlot`/`detail=` reference — only apps/web/src/shell/ShellPreview.tsx (the `?shell` dev harness) and apps/web/src/kit/KitGallery.tsx construct one; apps/web/src/session/SessionView.tsx still never passes AppShell a `detail` prop, so nothing in the live transcript triggers it (unchanged since PASS 2 — no cross-surface commit since then touched SessionView's detail wiring). Deliberately NOT attempted this pass: E7 needs real backend-grounded records (resource_link parts today carry no row-count/size/provenance the DetailSlot's Provenance/Recreate tabs need — see transcript/parts/ArtifactChip.tsx's own doc comment), which is a transcript-and-backend feature with its own tracked scope (backlog item E7, 'mint real artifacts and ground the chips'), not a panels-chrome fix. A minimal reachability stub grounded ONLY in a resource_link part's own real fields (uri/name/mime_type/description) was considered and rejected: it would mean two different, disagreeing code paths minting ArtifactRecords (a thin transcript-only one here, and E7's real one later), which the project's 'don't add a fifth store' / no-accretion rules argue against — better to land it once, correctly, than twice. Genuinely unbacked wire gap, reported as such, not silently omitted.
items.backend_surface: fetchSessionArtifacts already has the data; no UI trigger consumes it for this surface.
items.fix_hint: Add an artifact-chip/answer-open affordance in the transcript that sets a 'selected record' state and passes detail={<DetailSlot .../>} to AppShell (E7).

items.element: Detail slot chrome (kind badge, breadcrumb, copy/download, maximize, collapse-to-rail)
items.proto_truth: Header row: uppercase colored kind badge (e.g. 'ARTIFACT'); for artifact kind, a copy-markdown icon button and a download icon button (opens a menu: 'download file' / 'open storage location' / 'copy link to artifact'); a Maximize button (detExpand, grows to a centered 1120px-max modal with scrim); a 'Collapse panel' icon button (tgRight); a Close (×) button. Below: clickable breadcrumb trail (crumbs, e.g. 'session > earthscope_stations_…'). For artifact kind, a 3-way segmented sub-tab row labelled ARTIFACT / PROVENANCE / RECREATE.
items.audit_correction: INDEPENDENT AUDIT of grind pass 2 (2026-08-05) had corrected match -> deviates over the download affordance (see history). A separate PASS 3 pass on the icons-and-buttons surface (commit b921a7f7, same day) closed that out for real: apps/core gained Client.exportArtifact() (GET /v1/artifacts/{artifact_id}/export, clio-agent #973) and DetailSlot.tsx now renders the prototype's genuine 3-row menu (download file / open storage location / copy link to artifact), verified via screenshots/side-by-side/detail-download.png. This PANELS pass (PASS 3, 2026-08-05) re-verified that fix live against the current tree (still correct, 29/29 detail.test.tsx green) and found one more real chrome gap in the SAME item the icons-and-buttons pass didn't cover — the breadcrumb sub-element (this item's proto_truth explicitly names it): (1) the separator glyph was a hardcoded '/' where the prototype's own crumbs[] template (design/prototype/Clio Session.html, byte-level: 0xE2 0x80 0xBA) uses '›' (U+203A), not '/' or '>'; (2) the prototype's own crumbs are ALL real, focusable <button> elements (sc-camel-on-click={{ c.go }}), where this build rendered plain, inert <span>s despite the type's own doc-comment claiming 'Clickable trail'. Fixed conservatively: the FIRST ('session') crumb is now a real button wired to onClose — the only crumb with a well-defined destination in this app's data model, since DetailSlot shows a single record with no multi-level drill-down stack (the prototype's own last-crumb click is an observable no-op even in the ground truth, or setStack(stack.slice(0,i+1)) === the same stack — so a plain span for the trailing/self crumb is not a functional gap, it just isn't literally a <button> DOM node). Locked by 3 new failing-first tests (verified red against the pre-fix DetailSlot.tsx, green after) plus the existing 26.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/detail/DetailSlot.tsx: uppercase kind badge (Chip, defaults 'ARTIFACT' via ArtifactRecord.recordKind), a working copy-as-markdown button (real clipboard write of id/kind/size/sha/note), a REAL download menu (download file / copy link to artifact both call the live GET /v1/artifacts/{id}/export route via Client.exportArtifact(); open storage location stays the one honestly-degraded row, no browser API for the OS file manager — landed on icons-and-buttons, cross-verified here), a Maximize button that reopens the SAME content inside a centered <Layer width=1120> and restores on close, a Collapse button that shrinks to a 38px strip (re-expand chevron + vertical kind badge) and restores, and a breadcrumb row (ArtifactRecord.breadcrumb, rendered only when the caller supplies one — still nothing does in the live app, see the reachability item below) now using the prototype's own '›' separator and a real clickable 'session' crumb (onClose). First tab renamed 'overview' → 'artifact'. Tests: tests/unit/detail.test.tsx, 29 tests, all green (26 pre-existing + 3 new this pass). Composite: screenshots/side-by-side/panels-detail.png (this pass, via the `?shell` fixture harness — no live transcript trigger exists yet, see the reachability item) plus screenshots/side-by-side/detail-download.png (icons-and-buttons pass) — both confirm the chrome, download menu, and now the breadcrumb glyph/interactivity match the prototype.
items.backend_surface: GET /v1/artifacts/{artifact_id}/export (real, clio-agent #973) backs 'download file' and 'copy link to artifact'; 'open storage location' has no browser-reachable surface (desktop/OS concern) and is the one disclosed remaining wire gap in this item, matching the composer-attach-button degraded convention. Breadcrumb navigation beyond the first crumb is unbacked by design — no multi-level detail stack exists in the data model yet (ties to E7, not a separate wire gap).
